Based on the 'Basil of Baker Street' books, this 1986 Disney animated mystery pits a Holmes-emulating rodent sleuth against the criminal mastermind Professor Ratigan — which film is it?
The Great Mouse Detective: 1986 animated mystery film. The plot follows a mouse detective who undertakes to help a young mouse find and save her father from the criminal mastermind Professor Ratigan.
Which of these four was founded earliest?
English Football League (founded 1888) is the earliest of the four. The English Football League (EFL) is a league of professional football clubs from England and Wales.

This whiteface sad clown from 17th-century Parisian pantomime, dressed in a loose white blouse and wide pantaloons, always loses Columbine's heart to Harlequin — what's his stock name?

Pierrot (US also) is a stock character of pantomime and commedia dell'arte whose origins date back to the late 17th-century Italian troupe of players performing in Paris and known as the Comdie-Italienne.
